description: This file defines the UserDao class, which is responsible for data access operations related to User entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving users, retrieving users by various criteria, checking username existence, soft deleting users, and managing user roles. The class extends BaseDao and utilizes Doctrine ORM query builders to interact with the database.

classes.name: UserDao
classes.description: Data access object for managing User entities, including creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and complex search functionalities.

methods.name: saveSystemUser
methods.description: Persists a User entity to the database and returns the saved User.

methods.name: isExistingSystemUser
methods.description: Checks if a User with the given credentials exists in the system.

methods.name: getSystemUser
methods.description: Retrieves a User by their user ID if not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingSystemUserIds
methods.description: Returns an array of User IDs that exist among the provided list of IDs.

methods.name: getSystemUserIdList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all non-deleted User IDs.

methods.name: deleteSystemUsers
methods.description: Performs a soft delete on users identified by an array of IDs by setting their 'deleted' flag to true.

methods.name: getAssignableUserRoles
methods.description: Returns a list of UserRole entities that are marked as assignable.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Fetches a UserRole entity based on its role name.

methods.name: getSearchSystemUsersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of users matching the specified search filters.

methods.name: searchSystemUsers
methods.description: Returns an array of User entities matching the specified search filters.

methods.name: getSearchUserPaginator
methods.description: Helper method that sets up a paginator for user search queries based on filters.

methods.name: getEmployeesByUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves employees assigned to a specific user role, with options to include inactive or terminated employees.

methods.name: isUserNameExistByUserName
methods.description: Checks if a username already exists in the system, optionally excluding a specific user ID.

methods.name: getUserByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity by username.

methods.name: getDefaultAdminUser
methods.description: Gets the default admin user, which has no creator and a non-null password.
